Behind and beside him is the carriage's own window: a polished dark mahogany frame with thin brass trim, and a broad wooden sill running along the bottom of the picture with a small blank brass plate on it. On the sill at the far left a small striped tabby cat sleeps curled up next to a navy conductor's cap, as in reference image 2. Outside the window, as in reference image 2: bright midday, green flower meadow, deep blue lake, far shore village, snowy mountains, big white clouds. No bird, no paper, nothing in his hand. Clear daylight on the boy, no dark shadow over him.
